# SONSOH NIGHT

> Flush-fit sleep earbuds for side sleepers, with soundscapes, noise-masking, a sleep timer and a core of genuine Karelian shungite, made by SONSOH and currently in pre-order.

SONSOH NIGHT is a pair of wireless sleep earbuds that sit fully inside the outer ear, so nothing protrudes for a pillow to press on. Specified weight is 2.9 g per earbud, with dual-flange silicone tips in three sizes. The earbuds play for up to six hours per night and the charging case (LED battery display, USB-C) holds three more full charges, about a week of nights. Bluetooth Ultra-Low Energy and a sleep timer that switches the radio off once you are asleep. Two finishes: Midnight and Cloud. Specifications are provisional pending final production. NIGHT is a consumer audio product, not a medical or protective device.

Pre-order: the Founders Batch is 500 numbered pairs at €119 (launch price €149), or the Night Duo (two pairs) at €199. Reserving costs nothing; buyers receive a payment link when their number is ready to ship. The shipping date is not confirmed yet. Every pair has a 30-night trial and a 2-year warranty. Free shipping to the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Contact is through the form on the contact page.
